items.mainDefect: The new `retryCount: { gt: 1 }` OR branch in the SMS cron's deleteMany has no `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` filter, so it also deletes reminders for other methods such as EMAIL.

secondary.defect: The new `retryCount > 1` delete branch also has no `scheduledDate` bound, so it deletes reminders whatever their scheduled date.
